---
title: "Custom Placement"
format: html
extensions:
  support-this:
    position: custom
    description: "Your support keeps this work going."
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: username
      ko_fi: username
filters: [support-this]
---

To put the support section exactly where you want it, add an empty div with the `support-this` class at that spot.

## Configuration

```yaml
extensions:
  support-this:
    position: custom
    description: "Your support keeps this work going."
    platforms:
      github: coatless
      patreon: username
      ko_fi: username
filters: [support-this]
```

Then, in the body of the document:

```markdown
::: {.support-this}
:::
```

The section below replaces that div:

::: {.support-this}
:::

## How the div and `position` work together

- The div always wins. Even with `position: top` or the default `position: bottom`, the section goes where the div is, so one page can override a `position` set for a whole project.
- `position: custom` tells support-this to add the section only where you put a div. If a page has none, it gets no section and the render shows a warning.
- In RevealJS, the section stays on the slide that holds the div.
